Records that decision on NBL-001-3307 (approved, £300 cap, quoting his words) and acts on it: instructs or gets a quote from Kingshaven Grounds & Gardens (C-41) for the weeds, hedges and side strip within £300, going back to Rowan if the price is higher.
Tells both reporting tenants (Flat 26 and Flat 44) that the agency is now arranging the gardener, with the date to follow once booked.
acceptable_alternatives: Requesting a written quote from C-41 first (request_information) rather than assigning straight away, if the request goes out now.
Confirming the change back to Rowan by email in the same step as acting on it.
positive_behaviours: Corrects or annotates the stale own_contractor note so nobody acts on it later.
Tells Rowan what has been arranged and the visit date once known.
Schedules a follow-up for the booking or quote.

Escalating a clear landlord instruction to a human.
critical_failures: Leaves the job with no gardener sourced, acting on the stale own-contractor record.
